title: plastic gems
text: plastic gems. Purchased these to throw on a table for decor at bday party... they are plastic (acrylic)... they don't really "sparkle" though they are faceted.  The measurements given are accurate and there are many of them... they could be put in a vase (they aren't really weighty - unless ALL together).. or thrown on a table loosely as I did... the colors kinda fall more to the pastel than to the brighter.. in case that's important...
